posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...

So they read distinctly from the book, in the Law of God; and they gave the sense, and helped them to understand the reading. —Nehemiah 8:8

...Thru the Bible - Sunday Sermon   Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

In one of Dr. J. Vernon McGee’s most beloved messages, we’re taken to Exodus 19:4, where God says, “I bore you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.” It’s a beautiful reminder that God doesn’t just rescue us—He carries us. Be encouraged to trust His grace, not only to save us, but to lead us through every season of life.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-sunday-sermon/listen/on-eagles-wings-1289970.html?ref=sc

https://ttb.org/


...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

Talk to Him

He gives them here what may sound to you like the so-called “Lord’s Prayer,” but I believe that Christ didn’t intend it to become the thing I hear in public service today. It’s not a stilted form. And it’s not for a public service. This was to be spontaneous; it was personal. It’s to be like a conversation. And we just should talk to God. After all, He’s my Father. And I’m His son. He knows me and I don’t think He wants me to put on airs and assume an unnatural voice and try to use some flowery language. I think He just wants me to talk like Vernon McGee talks.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/talk-to-him-1291368.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

Blessed [are] they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled. (Matthew 5:6)

Your hunger shall be filled. Your thirst shall be quenched. Ever shall the child of righteousness be sated for the Lamb is his food and his drink. Christ is the living manna and the living water. The Christian feasts upon His body, broken for us, and His blood, shed for our sake. So go, O believer, in the power of the cross! Go forth and proclaim His life to all the nations until He comes again, that they too might taste the fullness of righteousness!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Handling the unexpected things in life...

And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross. -- Mark 15:21

Our God does amazing things when we face the unexpected.

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/handling-the-unexpected-things-in-life

C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (August 30th)

"Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed.' 'I have seen His ways, and will heal him." — Jeremiah 17:14; Isaiah 57:18

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (August 31st)

"On mine arm shall they trust." — Isaiah 51:5

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=244





...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm

“The sin underneath all our sins is to trust the lie of the serpent that we cannot trust the love and grace of Christ and must take matters into our own hands”

Martin Luther
